results.title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila
results.content: Leaders and representatives of the 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and their allies, are gathering in Manila for the bloc's biggest event of the year

results.title: Canada’s Carney visits Manila Cathedral, Fort Santiago after Marcos meeting
results.content: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, a devout Catholic, is given 'a glimpse of the rich history, faith, and cultural heritage of the Filipino people,' according to a social media post of the Manila Cathedral

results.title: Philippines, Australia ink updated defense cooperation deal
results.content: The Defense Cooperation Arrangement updates an earlier 1995 deal to serve as a ‘contemporary bilateral defense framework’ for the two countries

results.title: [Tambay] Tiis-ganda muna tayo para sa mga bisita ng ASEAN Summit
results.content: Kalma lang po ng isang linggo. Todo-pakita muna tayo ng walang kaparis na Filipino hospitality sa pag-estima ng mga lider ng iba’t ibang bansa

results.title: What to expect as 49th ASEAN Summit begins in Manila
results.content: The South China Sea Code of Conduct, Myanmar's political standing in ASEAN, and the Middle East crisis' impact on oil and food security will likely top the agenda
